name: 파오리
scene: At a windswept reed garden path in late-afternoon sun, balanced front three-quarter card-ready stance, both empty hands relaxed at her sides. Soft leaf shadows and golden rim light.
casual: Inside a warm home kitchen at early morning, leaning slightly toward a table and rolling a short bread dough cylinder with both hands resting gently on a wide rolling pin. Green herbs and cream tiles.
Cream sleeveless mock-neck knit top securely fitted, green high-waisted trousers and a narrow brown apron at the waist, bare arms shoulders and a small midriff gap, tiny leaf earrings.
At a sunny rural kite festival in late afternoon, turning during a slow walk and carrying a small folded paper kite horizontally across two open palms. Distant colorful kites, no other people.
Brown short-sleeved wrap blouse with secure cream inner panel, green high-waisted pleated mini skirt over opaque shorts, a woven belt, bare forearms neckline and legs, tiny feather pin.

At a sheltered public lakeshore deck at sunrise, kneeling on a dry wooden mat and carefully setting a pair of swim goggles beside her with one hand, other open palm rests on the mat. Head hands knees and feet visible; clear lake and reeds.

Fully lined cream-and-olive two-piece swimsuit with a secure broad-strap scoop-neck top and opaque high-waisted bottoms, brown edge piping, bare shoulders arms midriff and legs, tiny leaf-shaped hair clip.

comparison.changes: Different locations, specific activities, clothing silhouettes and compositions; mandatory categories alternate event fashion, lingerie and swimwear.

method: Actual Preact generator controls selected through repository DOM harness; output read once per asset.
